id: \bYou seem like you work well with a single type Pokémon.
en: \bYou seem like you work well with a single type Pokémon.
it: \bSembri uno che se la cava bene con Pokémon di un solo tipo.

id: \bYou can get to the Virbank Gym by boat. Or keep walking to get to the Opelucid Gym. Which will you do?
en: \bYou can get to the Virbank Gym by boat. Or keep walking to get to the Opelucid Gym. Which will you do?
it: \bPuoi raggiungere la Palestra di Virbopoli in barca. Oppure continuare a piedi fino alla Palestra di Boreduopoli. Cosa farai?

id: \bI suppose you know how to battle.
en: \bI suppose you know how to battle.
it: \bA quanto pare sai come si lotta.

id: \bThis boat goes to Virbank City. Give me some time to rest before we leave.
en: \bThis boat goes to Virbank City. Give me some time to rest before we leave.
it: \bQuesta barca va a Virbopoli. Dammi un po' di tempo per riposare prima di partire.

id: \rThe rain washes away. Starts the world anew.
en: \rThe rain washes away. Starts the world anew.
it: \rLa pioggia lava via tutto. Fa ricominciare il mondo da capo.

id: \bI'm on a mission. Don't bother me.
en: \bI'm on a mission. Don't bother me.

id: \rI knew battling you would be fun.
en: \rI knew battling you would be fun.
it: \rLo sapevo che lottare con te sarebbe stato divertente.

id: \bEver want to be in a movie?
en: \bEver want to be in a movie?
it: \bHai mai desiderato recitare in un film?

id: \bYou're not good enough to be on the big screen. Nobody would watch you.
en: \bYou're not good enough to be on the big screen.  Nobody would watch you.
it: \bNon sei abbastanza bravo per il grande schermo.  Nessuno ti guarderebbe.
